events.custom_event_name: [SCREEN FADES IN, REVEALING THE CHILDREN’S BEDROOM WITH WILLIAM’S SPRITE ON SCREEN, ACCOMPANIED BY THE SOUND OF A DOOR OPENING]

segments.text: Let’s look around for a moment.
Without hesitation, William steps deeper into the room and closes the door, eyeing each corner of the room with quiet intensity.
Hanging on the wall nearby, there are three paintings with Nathaniel’s distorted face on one canvas, William’s clear face on the other canvas, and one canvas left blank.
Shouldn’t Diana’s portrait be in this canvas?
And why is Nathan's painting distorted?
William eyes the blank canvas with a furrow between his brow. Surely he couldn’t forget that detail, did he?
Well… I guess these paintings are the anomalies, then.
Somehow, William seems to keep his eyes straightened to his brother’s distorted portrait.
The longer he looks, the more magnetic the canvas seems to tug at his soul, pulling him into the darkness.
Before William can even pull himself, the canvas devours him with a heavy pull as his consciousness gets swallowed into the painting.

segments.text: Okay, I’ve had enough of this…
